violations.text: The non-food contact surfaces of the shelves have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Chest freezers have an accumulation of frost and debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The floors throughout the facility, especially around the mop sink, have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

Chemicals observed stored with food, equipment, utensils, or single service items. Chemicals must be stored to prevent the contamination of clean equipment, utensils linens, and/or single service by spacing or partitioning and locating them in an area that is not above food, equipment utensils, linens, and single service articles. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

Scoop observed in dry ingredient container with the handle in the product. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024

Single service items observed stored on the floor in the front service area, and in 2 back storage areas. Single service items must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of numerous food containers have an accumulation of stickers. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024
The door to the toilet room was observed propped open. Toilet room doors must be kept closed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2024
Hand sink in the toilet room is lacking proper signage. New Violation. Correct By: 08/09/2024
The door to the toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 08/09/2024
The floor and wall junctures in the kitchen do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/09/2024
